card.name: Prepositions before month names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, from, around or usually-in that come right before an expected month name or month-based time span. Seen mostly in general text about seasons, flowering times and yearly cycles.

modes.label: Preposition before a month
modes.description: The word in, from or around sits right before a month name like February or June.
modes.example: Influenza usually ramps up<< in>> February, long after many people have forgotten

modes.label: Start of a season range
modes.description: The word from opens a range of months describing how long a season lasts.
modes.example: during the growing season, which lasts<< from>> November to June.

modes.label: Schedule by month
modes.description: A word in a stepwise schedule that leads into a monthly interval.
modes.example: at least once weekly for the first month,<< once>> every other week for the second month,

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word month, and away from year words.
card.plain: It fires on little words like "in" or "from" when a month name is about to come next.
